cohort: Three pregnant patients admitted with acute pancreatitis between January 2013 and June 2015 at M. S. Ramaiah Medical College and Hospital, Bengaluru, India.
finding: Acute pancreatitis in pregnancy was associated with preterm spontaneous vaginal delivery (33.3%), Cesarean section (66.7%), perinatal mortality (33.3%), and acute respiratory distress syndrome (33.3%).
mod_finding: Cesarean section rate was 66.7%, while preterm spontaneous vaginal delivery rate was 33.3%.
